title: Portal
description: Solve first-person physics puzzles inside a mysterious research facility. Place linked portals to redirect yourself and objects through each test chamber.

title: Portal 2
description: Explore an abandoned science facility with a portal gun, solve spatial puzzles, and discover a darkly comic story. A separate cooperative campaign lets two players solve chambers together.

title: Stardew Valley
description: Build a peaceful farm, grow crops, care for animals, fish, and make friends in a small town. Explore mines and share your farm with friends.

title: Terraria
description: Dig, explore, craft, and build in a two-dimensional sandbox world. Discover caves, gather resources, and fight bosses alone or with friends.

title: Valheim
description: Survive in a world inspired by Norse mythology. Gather resources, craft equipment, build a home, sail to new lands, and battle bosses with friends.

title: Don't Starve Together
description: Work together to survive a strange wilderness. Gather food, craft tools, prepare for changing seasons, and manage the threats of the night.

title: Project Zomboid
description: Try to survive a zombie outbreak in an open sandbox. Scavenge supplies, build defenses, manage hunger and injury, and explore deserted towns.

title: Rust
description: Gather resources, build a base, and survive against other players in a hostile online world. Craft weapons and defend your shelter with a team.

title: ARK: Survival Evolved
description: Survive on an island populated by dinosaurs. Craft tools, build settlements, tame creatures, and explore with other players.

title: Slay the Spire
description: Build a deck of cards as you climb a dangerous spire. Combine card effects, choose branching paths, and adapt your strategy to changing encounters.

title: Hades
description: Battle through the Greek underworld with fast action combat. Each escape attempt offers new powers, weapons, and conversations with mythological characters.

title: Dead Cells
description: Explore a changing castle with fast two-dimensional combat. Collect weapons, learn enemy patterns, and begin another run after defeat.

title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
description: Explore randomly arranged rooms, battle strange enemies, and combine unusual items. Every run changes the challenges and powers you discover.

title: Enter the Gungeon
description: Dodge projectiles and explore a shifting dungeon filled with unusual weapons. Master fast encounters and collect new items across repeated runs.

title: Hollow Knight
description: Explore a ruined insect kingdom through connected underground areas. Discover secrets, gain movement abilities, and face demanding battles.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Travel through an open fantasy world as a monster hunter. Follow story quests, investigate mysteries, and make choices that affect characters.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Explore a futuristic city as a mercenary. Follow story missions, customize your abilities, and approach encounters with weapons, stealth, or hacking.

title: ELDEN RING
description: Explore a vast fantasy landscape full of secrets and dangerous enemies. Develop a character, discover equipment, and overcome demanding boss battles.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Lead a party through a fantasy adventure shaped by dialogue and decisions. Use turn-based tactical combat, develop relationships, and explore with friends.

title: Divinity: Original Sin 2
description: Guide a party through a fantasy story with many possible approaches. Combine elemental abilities in turn-based combat and play cooperatively.

title: Horizon Zero Dawn Complete Edition
description: Explore a world where mechanical creatures roam the wilderness. Hunt with a bow, gather resources, and uncover the story of a lost civilization.

title: God of War
description: Journey through a mythological world with a father and son. Fight with an axe, solve environmental puzzles, and follow a character-focused adventure.

title: Factorio
description: Design automated production lines on an alien planet. Mine resources, connect machines with conveyor belts, and expand increasingly complex factories.

title: RimWorld
description: Manage a colony of survivors whose personalities shape their stories. Build shelter, produce food, and respond to disasters and visitors.

title: Cities: Skylines
description: Plan and manage a growing city. Design roads, organize public services, and solve transportation and development problems.

title: Stellaris
description: Lead a civilization into space, explore star systems, and meet alien empires. Manage an interstellar economy and pursue diplomacy or warfare.

title: Crusader Kings III
description: Guide a medieval dynasty through generations of politics and relationships. Shape succession, form alliances, and manage a changing realm.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2
description: Drive freight trucks between European cities. Deliver cargo, grow a transport business, and enjoy long journeys along highways.

title: Farming Simulator 22
description: Manage a farm using agricultural machinery. Plant and harvest crops, care for animals, and expand your farming business with friends.

title: Elite Dangerous
description: Pilot a spacecraft in a large galaxy. Explore star systems, trade goods, complete missions, and engage in space combat.

title: Dota 2
description: Join a team of heroes in a competitive arena. Coordinate abilities and strategy to push across the map and destroy the opposing team's base.

title: Counter-Strike 2
description: Coordinate with a team in tactical first-person shooting matches. Manage equipment, hold positions, and compete in objective-based rounds.

title: Team Fortress 2
description: Choose a character class and work with a team in objective-based battles. Combine distinct weapons and abilities in colorful multiplayer combat.

title: Little Nightmares
description: Guide a small character through an unsettling world. Solve environmental puzzles, sneak past threats, and explore eerie spaces.

title: BattleBlock Theater
description: Navigate colorful platforming challenges and solve obstacles with a friend. Collect gems, avoid hazards, and complete playful puzzle stages.

title: Castle Crashers
description: Play as a knight in a colorful side-scrolling adventure. Fight enemies, collect weapons, and progress through stages with friends.
